case_number: Bhupinder Singh vs Unitech Ltd. on 23 March, 2023
summary: Dispute over land sale proceeds; Unitech as sole owner sought restitution of misappropriated funds; Rs. 56.11 crores to Naresh Kempanna and Rs. 41.96 crores to Mohinder Khaira disbursed via Dhingra Committee report without adjudication; MOU dated 02.01.2018 basis questioned; restitution principle applied citing Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal; court error in fund allocation corrected.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; restitution ordered for misappropriated funds; amounts paid to Kempanna and Khaira to be disgorged; sale proceeds to Unitech as rightful owner.
